name: Athens
vibe: ~3 hours in the airport. Arrive 9:15 AM domestic, depart 12:10 PM international. Must reclaim checked bags between separate tickets (SKY express → Delta).

activities.name: Greek coffee (elliniko)
activities.description: Get a proper Greek coffee at any terminal café. Your last taste of Greece.

activities.name: Bougatsa or tyropita
activities.description: Custard pastry (bougatsa) or cheese pie (tyropita) — essential airport food.

activities.name: Goldair Handling lounge
activities.description: If you have access via AMEX or Delta status. Solid lounge.

specialNotes.title: Bag Reclaim Required
specialNotes.body: SKY express and Delta are separate tickets. Bags will NOT auto-transfer. Exit domestic arrivals, reclaim bags, re-check at Delta international departures. Allow 30 min.
